blocks.text: **had better** + fe'l (`to` siz) — aniq vaziyatda shu ishni qilish **ma'qul**, aks holda muammo, xavf yoki noqulaylik bo'ladi. Og'zaki nutqda deyarli doim qisqa shaklda: I**'d better**, you**'d better**, we**'d better**. **had** — o'tgan zamon shakli, lekin ma'no **hozirgi yoki kelasi**: I**'d better** go now — Endi **ketganim ma'qul** (hozir). O'zbekchada «**-ganim ma'qul**», «**yaxshisi, ...**», ko'pincha davomi bilan: «...bo'lmasa kechikaman».

items.text: The battery is almost dead — I**'d better** charge my phone before we leave.
items.translation: Quvvat deyarli tugadi — chiqishdan oldin telefonimni **quvvatlab olganim ma'qul**.

items.text: You**'d better not** touch that pan — it's still very hot.
items.translation: U tovaga **tegmaganing ma'qul** — hali juda issiq.

blocks.text: had better va should — farqi nimada?

**should** — umumiy maslahat yoki fikr, har qanday vaziyat uchun (→ 33-dars). **had better** — faqat **aniq, hozirgi** vaziyat uchun va uning ortida doim yashirin «**aks holda ...**» bor. Shuning uchun umumiy fikrlarda had better ishlatilmaydi: «Everyone had better learn first aid» emas, Everyone **should** learn first aid. Yana bir nozik joy: ikkinchi shaxsga **You'd better ...** ba'zan buyruq yoki hatto tahdid kabi eshitiladi (You**'d better** pay me back!). Xushmuomala maslahat uchun **I think you should ...** yumshoqroq.

rows: umumiy maslahat: People **should** drink more water.
faqat aniq vaziyat: You look pale — you**'d better** drink some water.
fikr: I think the city **should** build more parks.
ogohlantirish: We**'d better** leave now, or we'll miss the train.

items.text: Students **should** read the news in English every day.
items.translation: Talabalar har kuni ingliz tilida yangiliklar **o'qishi kerak**.

items.text: The test starts in an hour, so you**'d better** stop chatting and revise.
items.translation: Test bir soatdan keyin boshlanadi, shuning uchun gapni qo'yib, **takrorlaganing ma'qul**.

blocks.text: had better hech qachon o'zgarmaydi: «have better», «has better» yoki «had better to» deyilmaydi. O'tmishdagi afsus uchun had better emas, **should have done** ishlatiladi: I **should have left** earlier (→ 33-dars).
It's time to ... / It's time for somebody to ...

**It's time to** + fe'l — biror ish qilish **vaqti keldi**: It's time **to go** — **Ketish vaqti bo'ldi**. Kim qilishi kerakligini aytish uchun **for** + kishi + **to** + fe'l: It's time **for the children to** go to bed — Bolalarning **uxlash vaqti bo'ldi**. Bu qoliplar neytral: faqat vaqt kelganini bildiradi, hech kimni ayblamaydi.

items.text: Right, everyone, it's time **to** start the meeting.
After the long winter, it's time **for** the farmers **to** prepare their fields.
items.translation: Uzoq qishdan keyin fermerlarning dalalarini **tayyorlash vaqti keldi**.

blocks.text: It's time somebody did ... — o'tgan zamon, hozirgi ma'no

**It's time** + ega + **Past Simple** — shakli o'tmish, ma'nosi **hozirgi**: bu ish **allaqachon** qilinishi kerak edi, biz kechikdik. Ko'pincha tanqid yoki shikoyat ohangida: It's time you **got** a job — Allaqachon ishga **kiradigan vaqting keldi**. **It's about time** va **It's high time** — yanada kuchliroq, sabrsizlik bilan. Solishtiring: It's time **to go** (vaqti keldi, neytral) — It's time we **went** (kech bo'ldi, allaqachon ketishimiz kerak edi). O'zbekchada: «**-adigan vaqt allaqachon keldi**», «**endi ... -sang-chi**».

items.text: You've had that cough for a month — it's time you **saw** a doctor.
items.translation: Bir oydan beri yo'talyapsiz — allaqachon **shifokorga ko'rinadigan vaqtingiz keldi**.

items.text: It's high time the council **fixed** the street lights in our area.
items.translation: Hokimiyatning mahallamizdagi ko'cha chiroqlarini **tuzatadigan vaqti allaqachon keldi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «You had better to go» → You**'d better go** (`to` yo'q); «You'd better went» → You**'d better go** (fe'l doim asosiy shaklda); «You hadn't better do it» → You**'d better not** do it (not — better dan keyin); «It's time we go home» → It's time we **went** home yoki It's time **to go** home; umumiy maslahatda had better ishlatish: «Children had better eat vegetables» → Children **should** eat vegetables.

had better ni tanlashdan oldin gapga xayolan «**..., aks holda ...**» qo'shib ko'ring. Mantiqiy davom bo'lsa (We'd better go, **or** we'll be late) — had better to'g'ri. It's time + o'tgan zamonni esa «**allaqachon ...adigan payt keldi**» deb tekshiring: allaqachon so'zi o'rinli bo'lsa — It's time we **left**.

examples.title: **had better**: do it, or there'll be a problem
examples.description: had better / 'd better + fe'l — aniq vaziyatda shu ishni qilish ma'qul, aks holda muammo bo'ladi. O'zbekchada «-ganim ma'qul», «yaxshisi».

sentences.text: Look at those clouds — we**'d better** take an umbrella.
sentences.translation: Anavi bulutlarga qara — yaxshisi, **soyabon olib olaylik**.

sentences.text: I**'d better** go now, or I'll miss the last bus to Chilanzar.
sentences.translation: Endi **ketganim ma'qul**, bo'lmasa Chilonzorga ketadigan oxirgi avtobusdan qolib ketaman.

sentences.text: You**'d better** charge your phone before the trip, because there are no sockets on the coach.
sentences.translation: Safardan oldin telefoningizni **quvvatlab olganingiz ma'qul**, chunki avtobusda rozetka yo'q.

sentences.text: Madina **had better** start packing — her flight to Istanbul leaves at six in the morning.
sentences.translation: Madina **yig'ishtirishni boshlagani ma'qul** — Istanbulga reysi ertalab soat oltida.

sentences.text: The fridge is almost empty, so we**'d better** go shopping after work.
sentences.translation: Muzlatkich deyarli bo'm-bo'sh, shuning uchun ishdan keyin **xarid qilgani borganimiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: If you've got a temperature, you**'d better** stay at home today.
sentences.translation: Agar isitmangiz bo'lsa, bugun **uyda qolganingiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Tom **had better** apologise to Kate before she tells everyone what happened.
sentences.translation: Keyt hammaga nima bo'lganini aytib bermasidan oldin Tom undan **kechirim so'ragani ma'qul**.

sentences.text: The meeting starts in ten minutes — I**'d better** print the agenda.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish o'n daqiqadan keyin boshlanadi — kun tartibini **chop etib olganim ma'qul**.

sentences.text: **Hadn't** we **better** check the address again before we set off?
sentences.translation: Yo'lga chiqishdan oldin manzilni yana bir **tekshirib olsak yaxshi emasmi**?

sentences.text: You**'d better** be on time tomorrow — the director himself is coming to the meeting.
sentences.translation: Ertaga **vaqtida kelganingiz ma'qul** — yig'ilishga direktorning o'zi keladi.

examples.title: **had better not**: don't do it
examples.description: had better not + fe'l — buni qilmagan ma'qul, aks holda yomon bo'ladi. not doim better dan keyin keladi.

sentences.text: I**'d better not** drink coffee this late, or I won't sleep.
sentences.translation: Bunday kech **qahva ichmaganim ma'qul**, aks holda uxlay olmayman.

sentences.text: You**'d better not** park there — the traffic wardens are very strict in this street.
sentences.translation: U yerga **mashina qo'ymaganingiz ma'qul** — bu ko'chada jarima soluvchilar juda qattiqqo'l.

sentences.text: We**'d better not** tell Grandma about the accident until she's feeling better.
sentences.translation: Buvim o'zini yaxshi his qilmaguncha, unga avariya haqida **aytmaganimiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Jasur **had better not** forget his passport again, like last time.
sentences.translation: Jasur o'tgan safargidek pasportini yana **unutib qo'ymagani ma'qul**.

sentences.text: This ice is thin, so the kids **had better not** walk on the lake.
sentences.translation: Muz yupqa, shuning uchun bolalar ko'l ustida **yurmagani ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Sarah **had better not** spend all her savings on that car — she'll need money for university.
sentences.translation: Sara butun jamg'armasini o'sha mashinaga **sarflamagani ma'qul** — unga universitet uchun pul kerak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Take the key with you, but you**'d better not** lose it — it's the only one.
sentences.translation: Kalitni olib ket, lekin uni **yo'qotmaganing ma'qul** — boshqasi yo'q.

sentences.text: After that heavy dinner, I think I**'d better not** have dessert.
sentences.translation: Shunday to'yimli kechki ovqatdan keyin, menimcha, **shirinlik yemaganim ma'qul**.

sentences.text: They**'d better not** be late again, or the coach will leave without them.
sentences.translation: Ular yana **kechikmagani ma'qul**, bo'lmasa avtobus ularsiz jo'nab ketadi.

sentences.text: Oliver, you **had better not** say anything about the prices in front of the customers.
sentences.translation: Oliver, mijozlar oldida narxlar haqida hech narsa **demaganing ma'qul**.

examples.title: **had better** or **should**?
examples.description: should — umumiy maslahat va fikr; had better — aniq, hozirgi vaziyat va ogohlantirish. Gaplarni juft-juft solishtiring.

sentences.text: In general, you **should** back up your photos once a month.
sentences.translation: Umuman olganda, suratlaringizning zaxira nusxasini oyiga bir marta **olib turishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Your laptop is making a strange noise — you**'d better** back up your files right now.
sentences.translation: Noutbukingiz g'alati ovoz chiqaryapti — fayllaringizning zaxira nusxasini **hoziroq olganingiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Students **should** read as much as possible in English, not only textbooks.
sentences.translation: Talabalar faqat darsliklarni emas, ingliz tilida iloji boricha ko'p **o'qishi kerak**.

sentences.text: The essay is due tomorrow, so Bekzod **had better** finish it tonight.
sentences.translation: Insho ertaga topshiriladi, shuning uchun Bekzod uni bugun kechqurun **tugatgani ma'qul**.

sentences.text: I think the government **should** invest more in renewable energy.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, hukumat qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga ko'proq **sarmoya kiritishi kerak**.

sentences.text: We**'d better** turn off the lights — the electricity bill was huge last month.
sentences.translation: **Chiroqlarni o'chirib qo'yganimiz ma'qul** — o'tgan oy elektr uchun hisob juda katta keldi.

sentences.text: Do you think I **should** learn Chinese? It's becoming more and more useful.
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, xitoy tilini **o'rganishim kerakmi**? U tobora foydaliroq bo'lib boryapti.

sentences.text: There's a police car behind us, so you**'d better** slow down.
sentences.translation: Orqamizda politsiya mashinasi bor, shuning uchun **sekinlashganing ma'qul**.

sentences.text: As a general rule, children **shouldn't** spend hours in front of screens.
sentences.translation: Umumiy qoida sifatida, bolalar soatlab ekran oldida **o'tirmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: At this hour Aziz **had better not** play his music so loudly — the neighbours will complain.
sentences.translation: Bu mahalda Aziz musiqani bunchalik baland **qo'ymagani ma'qul** — qo'shnilar shikoyat qiladi.

examples.title: **It's time to** ... / **It's time for** somebody **to** ...
examples.description: It's time to + fe'l, It's time for + kishi + to + fe'l — biror ish qilish vaqti keldi. Neytral: hech kimni ayblamaydi.

sentences.text: Come on, children, **it's time for** bed — you've got school tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Qani, bolalar, **uxlash vaqti bo'ldi** — ertaga maktabga borasizlar.

sentences.text: After eight years in the same job, Kate feels **it's time to** look for something new.
sentences.translation: Bitta ishda sakkiz yil ishlagach, Keyt yangi narsa **izlash vaqti kelganini** his qilyapti.

sentences.text: **It's time for** the patients **to** take their evening medicine.
sentences.translation: Bemorlarning kechki **dorini ichish vaqti bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Well, **it's time to** say goodbye — thank you all for a wonderful evening.
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, **xayrlashish vaqti keldi** — ajoyib oqshom uchun barchangizga rahmat.

sentences.text: When you start forgetting things, maybe **it's time to** take a proper holiday.
sentences.translation: Narsalarni unutadigan bo'lib qolsangiz, balki **yaxshilab dam olish vaqti kelgandir**.

sentences.text: **It's time for** us **to** decide where we're going this summer.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz qayerga borishimizni **hal qiladigan vaqt keldi**.

sentences.text: Look at the clock — **it's time for** Dilnoza **to** leave for the airport.
sentences.translation: Soatga qara — Dilnozaning aeroportga **jo'nash vaqti bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Don't you think **it's time to** replace this old sofa?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, bu eski divanni **almashtirish vaqti kelmadimi**?

sentences.text: **It is time for** all passengers **to** board the plane, so please go to gate 12.
sentences.translation: Barcha yo'lovchilarning samolyotga **chiqish vaqti bo'ldi**, iltimos, 12-chiqish eshigiga boring.

sentences.text: With two kids and a dog, the Smiths decided **it was time to** buy a bigger car.
sentences.translation: Ikki bola va itli bo'lgach, Smitlar oilasi kattaroq mashina **sotib olish vaqti keldi** degan qarorga keldi.

examples.title: **It's time** somebody **did** ...: it's already late
examples.description: It's time + ega + Past Simple — ma'no hozirgi: bu ish allaqachon qilinishi kerak edi. Ko'pincha tanqid yoki shikoyat ohangida.

sentences.text: **It's time** the government **did** something about air pollution in the city.
sentences.translation: Hukumatning shahardagi havo ifloslanishiga qarshi biror **chora ko'radigan vaqti allaqachon keldi**.

sentences.text: Your room is a mess — **it's time** you **tidied** it.
sentences.translation: Xonang ag'dar-to'ntar — uni **yig'ishtiradigan vaqting bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Honestly, **it's time** Jasur **found** a proper job instead of playing games all day.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, Jasurning kun bo'yi o'yin o'ynamay, durustroq ish **topadigan vaqti keldi**.

sentences.text: Look, it's eleven o'clock — **it's time** we **went** home.
sentences.translation: Qara, soat o'n bir — **uyga ketadigan vaqtimiz bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: The kids are growing up, so **it's time** they **learnt** to cook for themselves.
sentences.translation: Bolalar ulg'ayib qoldi, endi o'zlariga ovqat **qilishni o'rganadigan vaqtlari keldi**.

sentences.text: **It's time** somebody **told** Oliver that his jokes aren't funny any more.
sentences.translation: Kimdir Oliverga hazillari endi kulgili emasligini **aytadigan payt keldi**.

sentences.text: Don't you think **it's time** the company **paid** its staff a little more?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, kompaniyaning xodimlarga biroz ko'proq **maosh to'laydigan vaqti kelmadimi**?

sentences.text: You've been talking about that course for months — **it's time** you **signed up**.
sentences.translation: O'sha kurs haqida oylardan beri gapiryapsiz — endi **yoziladigan vaqtingiz keldi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod is almost thirty, so his mother thinks **it's time** he **got** married.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'ttizga kirib qoldi, shuning uchun onasi uning **uylanadigan vaqti keldi** deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: **It is time** you **stopped** making excuses and **started** taking responsibility.
sentences.translation: Bahona qilishni **bas qilib**, mas'uliyatni o'z zimmangizga **oladigan vaqtingiz keldi**.

examples.title: **It's about time** / **It's high time**: impatience
examples.description: It's about time / It's high time + Past Simple — kuchli sabrsizlik: «allaqachon vaqti kelgan edi». Qisqa javob: About time!

sentences.text: **It's about time** you **called** your grandmother — she hasn't heard from you for weeks.
sentences.translation: Buvingga **qo'ng'iroq qiladigan payt allaqachon keldi** — u haftalardan beri sendan xabar olmagan.

sentences.text: The trains are always late — **it's high time** the railway company **invested** in new ones.
sentences.translation: Poyezdlar doim kechikadi — temir yo'l kompaniyasining yangi poyezdlarga **sarmoya kiritadigan vaqti allaqachon keldi**.

sentences.text: Listen, **it's high time** we **had** a serious talk about our family budget.
sentences.translation: Quloq sol, oilaviy byudjetimiz haqida jiddiy **gaplashib oladigan vaqt allaqachon keldi**.

sentences.text: You're finally getting a haircut? **About time**!
sentences.translation: Nihoyat sochingni oldiryapsanmi? **Vaqti ham kelgan edi**!

sentences.text: Nilufar has been engaged for three years, so her friends joke that **it's high time** she **set** a date.
sentences.translation: Nilufar uch yildan beri unashtirilgan, shuning uchun dugonalari uning to'y kunini **belgilaydigan vaqti allaqachon keldi** deb hazillashadi.

sentences.text: Isn't **it about time** the council **repaired** the potholes on our street?
sentences.translation: Hokimiyatning ko'chamizdagi chuqurlarni **tuzatadigan vaqti allaqachon kelmadimi**?

sentences.text: In my opinion, **it's about time** people **stopped** throwing plastic bottles into the river.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, odamlarning daryoga plastik butilka **tashlashni bas qiladigan vaqti allaqachon keldi**.

sentences.text: Twenty minutes late again? **It's about time** you **bought** an alarm clock!
sentences.translation: Yana yigirma daqiqa kechikdingmi? Endi budilnik **sotib oladigan vaqting keldi**!

sentences.text: Mum keeps saying that **it's high time** I **learnt** to drive.
sentences.translation: Oyim mening **haydashni o'rganadigan vaqtim allaqachon kelganini** takrorlagani-takrorlagan.

sentences.text: Now that the kids have left home, **it's high time** Emma and James **travelled** a bit more.
sentences.translation: Bolalar uydan ketgan ekan, Emma bilan Jeymsning ko'proq **sayohat qiladigan vaqti allaqachon keldi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: leaving a friend's party
examples.description: Suhbat: bazmdan erta ketayotgan do'st — had better, had better not va It's time aralash.

sentences.text: — Oh no, look at the time! I**'d better** order a taxi.
sentences.translation: — Voy, vaqtni qara! **Taksi chaqirganim ma'qul**.

sentences.text: — Already? Surely **it's** not **time to** go yet — it's only ten.
sentences.translation: — Hozirdanmi? Hali **ketish vaqti** emas-ku — soat endi o'n.

sentences.text: — I know, but I've got an interview tomorrow, so I **had better not** stay up late.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman, lekin ertaga suhbatim bor, shuning uchun **kech yotmaganim ma'qul**.

sentences.text: — An interview? Then of course you**'d better** get some sleep.
sentences.translation: — Suhbat? Unda, albatta, yaxshilab **uxlab olganing ma'qul**.

sentences.text: — Exactly. And **it's time** I **started** taking my career seriously.
sentences.translation: — Aynan. Martabamga jiddiy **qaraydigan vaqtim keldi**.

sentences.text: — Good for you! But you**'d better** take some cake for the journey.
sentences.translation: — Barakalla! Lekin yo'lga tort **olib olganing ma'qul**.

sentences.text: — Thanks! I**'d better** say goodbye to your parents first, hadn't I?
sentences.translation: — Rahmat! Avval ota-onang bilan **xayrlashib olganim ma'qul**, shundaymi?

sentences.text: — Yes, they'd love that. You**'d better** hurry, though — they go to bed early.
sentences.translation: — Ha, ular xursand bo'lishadi. Faqat **shoshilganing ma'qul** — ular erta yotishadi.

sentences.text: — The taxi is outside. **It's high time** I **bought** a car of my own!
sentences.translation: — Taksi tashqarida. O'zimning mashinamni **sotib oladigan vaqtim allaqachon keldi**!

sentences.text: — Ha! Good luck tomorrow, and you**'d better** call me as soon as you hear anything.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Ertaga omad, natijani bilishing bilan menga **qo'ng'iroq qilganing ma'qul**.

examples.title: Mixed: warnings, advice and overdue changes
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: had better (not), should, It's time to va It's time + Past Simple.

sentences.text: The roads will be icy tonight, so you**'d better** leave the car at home.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechasi yo'llar muz bo'ladi, shuning uchun **mashinani uyda qoldirganing ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Patients **should** drink plenty of water, but you**'d better not** drink anything before the operation.
sentences.translation: Bemorlar ko'p suv ichishi **kerak**, lekin siz operatsiyadan oldin hech narsa **ichmaganingiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Kate thinks **it's time** she **moved** out of the city and **bought** a house with a garden.
sentences.translation: Keyt shahardan **ko'chib**, bog'li uy **sotib oladigan vaqti keldi** deb o'ylaydi.

sentences.text: If we want to see the sunrise over the Registan, we**'d better** set off at five.
sentences.translation: Registon ustida quyosh chiqishini ko'rmoqchi bo'lsak, soat beshda **yo'lga chiqqanimiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Twelve years with the same old phone — surely **it's time to** upgrade!
sentences.translation: O'n ikki yildan beri o'sha eski telefon — **yangilash vaqti** allaqachon keldi-ku!

sentences.text: The boss is in a terrible mood today, so I**'d better not** ask about my holiday.
sentences.translation: Boshliq bugun juda yomon kayfiyatda, shuning uchun ta'tilim haqida **so'ramaganim ma'qul**.

sentences.text: James **had better** renew his passport soon, because it expires in two months.
sentences.translation: Jeyms pasportini tez orada **yangilagani ma'qul**, chunki uning muddati ikki oyda tugaydi.

sentences.text: Many students believe **it's time** the city **built** a proper bus station near the new university.
sentences.translation: Ko'p talabalar shaharning yangi universitet yonida durust avtobus bekati **quradigan vaqti keldi** deb hisoblashadi.

sentences.text: You**'d better** write that down, or you'll forget it by tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Buni **yozib qo'yganing ma'qul**, aks holda ertagacha unutib qo'yasan.

sentences.text: Isn't it time you **forgave** your brother? It all happened such a long time ago.
sentences.translation: Akangni **kechiradigan vaqting kelmadimi**? Axir hammasi juda uzoq vaqt oldin bo'lgan.
